## Context / Problem
Follow-up (fix b) to creatable-foldable-arthropods (fix a, merged a0fc8d43556 / Gerrit 1761). A second, independent defect remains in the verifier's evidence-banking path: at SEARCH EXHAUSTION, `BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE` banks `met=false` — i.e. "the criterion is unmet" — when what the run actually established is only "the search budget ran out before sufficient evidence was found". This misattributes absence-of-evidence as evidence-of-absence, producing false FAIL verdicts on tickets whose evidence exists but was not reached within the window.

## Proposed fix
Make the banked evidence TRI-STATE: `met=true`, `met=false` (a positive refutation was actually found), and `insufficient_evidence` (search exhausted without a determination). The tri-state must originate in the banking WRITE path, whose chokepoints are all bool-typed today and must each change:
- `CompletionEvidencePolicy.fallback_record` (completion_tool_policy.py:100-101) currently passes a literal `False` through the record tool — at exhaustion it must bank the `insufficient_evidence` sentinel instead, via an internal write path (not the model-facing tool).
- `CriterionBank.upsert` (completion_banking.py:441-461, `"met": bool(met)` at :454) — widen to persist the tri-state (`met: bool | None` + explicit `state`; the "writes remain bool-only" docstring contract updates with it).
- `record_criterion_verdict`'s model-facing tool signature (:539) stays BOOL — `insufficient_evidence` is exclusively the policy-side exhaustion outcome, never a model-tool input.
- `harvest_structured_into_bank` (:583) hard-gates `isinstance(met, bool)` and would silently drop tri-state entries on re-harvest — widen so they survive round-trips.
At search exhaustion, `BOUNDED_FALLBACK_EVIDENCE` must bank `insufficient_evidence`, never `met=false`.

**Full consumer graph (all bool-coercing/validating sites change together):**
- **Schema (`src/rebar/schemas/completion_verdict.schema.json`)**: `criteria[].met` (:31, strict bool) becomes `boolean|null` + optional sibling `state` enum (`met`/`unmet`/`insufficient_evidence`; absent state + bool met stays valid for existing records); top-level `verdict` (:10-12) gains `INDETERMINATE`, emitted when no criterion is `unmet` but ≥1 is `insufficient_evidence` (any `unmet` dominates → FAIL). Both rendering seams validate against this schema (completion_recovery.py:674, :774) — prerequisite, not follow-up.
- **`_validate_coverage` (completion_recovery.py:364-368, run at :717)**: hard-raises on non-bool `met` — accept the tri-state while still rejecting untyped records; the :370 cross-check becomes state-aware (PASS = all met; INDETERMINATE = no unmet).
- **`_run_finalizer` (completion_recovery.py:741)**: `bool(entry.get('met'))` collapses the sentinel to false before the LLM finalizer sees it — render `insufficient_evidence` faithfully in the prompt payload.
- **Unbanked/exhausted placeholder branches** (`assemble_deterministic_verdict` :646-660, `merge_finalizer_with_bank` :715+): a never-banked criterion at exhaustion IS absence-of-evidence — placeholders bank/render `insufficient_evidence` (keeping the `exhausted` marker) instead of `met:false` + FAIL finding.
- **`reconcile_verdict` (src/rebar/llm/completion.py:495-522)**: `:522` coerces any non-PASS to FAIL, on every path (completion.py:601, gate_ops.py:297, completion_sidecar.py:323) — pass INDETERMINATE through with its own remediation text; unknown tokens still coerce to FAIL.
- **Close-gate refusal (close_precheck.py:571-589)**: gates on non-PASS and asserts "FAILED … unmet criteria" — on INDETERMINATE it still refuses (fail-closed) but reports insufficient evidence + remediation, not unmet criteria.
- **Completion sidecar (`src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py:335`)**: persists `criteria` as-is — verified pass-through; a round-trip test pins it, no code change expected. Both verdict-rendering seams — `assemble_deterministic_verdict` (completion_banking.py:619-640) and `merge_finalizer_with_bank` (:705-714) — must render `insufficient_evidence` as INDETERMINATE, not FAIL. **Close-gate behavior (fail-closed):** an `insufficient_evidence` criterion still BLOCKS the close — the gate does not pass on missing evidence — but the refusal carries the INDETERMINATE remediation messaging (re-run verification, widen the search scope, or operator-attest the criterion) instead of asserting the criterion affirmatively FAILED. The behavioral change is honesty of the message and the recorded verdict class, not gate leniency.

## Scope
- The banking WRITE path: `fallback_record` wiring in src/rebar/llm/completion_tool_policy.py (exhaustion site), and in src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_banking.py: `CriterionBank.upsert` (schema widening), `record_criterion_verdict` (unchanged bool tool signature — guard only), `harvest_structured_into_bank` (gate widening so tri-state entries survive re-harvest), and BOTH unbanked/exhausted placeholder branches (assemble_deterministic_verdict :646-660, merge_finalizer_with_bank :715+).
- src/rebar/schemas/completion_verdict.schema.json — criteria[].met boolean|null + state enum + INDETERMINATE verdict token (backward compatible).
- src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_recovery.py — `_validate_coverage` tri-state acceptance + state-aware PASS/INDETERMINATE cross-check; `_run_finalizer` banked-evidence payload renders the sentinel faithfully (:741).
- src/rebar/llm/completion.py — `reconcile_verdict` passes INDETERMINATE through with its own remediation instead of coercing to FAIL.
- src/rebar/_commands/close_precheck.py — refusal message distinguishes INDETERMINATE (insufficient evidence + remediation) from FAIL (unmet criteria); still refuses both.
- src/rebar/llm/completion_sidecar.py — verified pass-through (round-trip test only; no code change expected).
- The evidence schema + BOTH consumer seams that render per-criterion verdicts from banked evidence: `assemble_deterministic_verdict` and `merge_finalizer_with_bank` in src/rebar/llm/workflow/completion_banking.py.
- Tests: a search-exhaustion run banks insufficient_evidence (not met=false); a genuine refutation still banks met=false; verdict rendering distinguishes the two.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At search exhaustion, banked fallback evidence is `insufficient_evidence`, not `met=false`; checked by a new unit test.
- [ ] An `insufficient_evidence` bank entry survives `harvest_structured_into_bank` round-trips (not silently dropped) and the model-facing `record_criterion_verdict` tool signature remains bool-only; unit tests.
- [ ] A genuine positive refutation still banks `met=false` and still yields FAIL; checked by a guard test.
- [ ] BOTH rendering seams — `assemble_deterministic_verdict` and `merge_finalizer_with_bank` — render `insufficient_evidence` as indeterminate-with-remediation, not FAIL, INCLUDING their unbanked/exhausted placeholder branches; checked per-seam and per-branch by rendering tests.
- [ ] The widened completion_verdict schema validates tri-state records and still validates existing all-bool records; `_validate_coverage` accepts the tri-state and still rejects untyped records; `_run_finalizer`'s banked-evidence payload carries the sentinel unconverted; sidecar round-trip preserves the state field; unit tests each.
- [ ] The close gate still BLOCKS on an `insufficient_evidence` criterion (fail-closed) and its refusal (close_precheck.py) carries the INDETERMINATE remediation guidance, not a FAIL/unmet-criteria assertion; `reconcile_verdict` passes INDETERMINATE through unconverted; gate-behavior + reconcile tests.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` clean; lands via Gerrit (LLM-Review +1 AND Verified +1) before close.

## Out of scope
Guard/memo interaction (fix a, landed); verifier prompt changes; retry policy.
